blurb: Current Culture Fly offers guided fly fishing trips targeting species like shad, striper, largemouth bass, red drum, brook trout, and musky in various Virginia locations. They also provide fly fishing classes for all skill levels and sell custom fly fishing gear and apparel. Trips include lunch on full day outings and are led by US Coast Guard licensed captains or experienced guides.

quotes.text: I had an incredible experience with Current Culture! The free casting clinic they offered was extermely helpful in improving my skills and Simón was an engaging and patient instructor. I went on a saltwater fly fishing guided trip with Simón, and it was nothing short of amazing - even with my novice casting skills. I wasn't sure what to expect out of the trip and sight casting for redfish exceeded all of my expectations! I highly recommend this shop and their guided trips for both beginners and experienced anglers. They truly go above and beyond to make your fishing experience unforgettable.

THESE GUYS ARE THE BEST IN THE BUSINESS! Whether you're looking for gear, advice, lessons or full guided trips, this is the place to go. I've been on a couple of trips with Capt Sammy, both for Striper on the James, and Redfish in the bay, and was blown away by his knowledge and skill. I've been fly fishing for a decade or two, and i learned more on those trips than I have in all that time. Not to mention, caught oodles of fish. Good prices, good people, good fish. Hit 'em up, you won't regret it. If you're a fisher-person, fly or spin, don't come to Richmond without stopping by this shop.

Current Culture Family I’ve been coming here for about a year or so now. They have everything you need to get on the fish but more importantly it’s a great community. Reid, Simón and Mechas (the owners) are more than willing to share there knowledge and love of the sport. Anytime I have a big fly fishing trip coming up I run over there for advice and tactics. If your trying to get into fly fishing or a veteran of the sport, I definitely recommend joining the family at current culture fly.

High School Trip I’ve had the opportunity to fish with Simón and Reid personally and as a part of a high school group as a chaperone. These guys get it. They are patient, excellent teachers, super knowledgeable and passionate about fishing. Their shop is unpretentious and well-equipped. Whether you are a novice or seasoned angler, pay these guys a visit. They always go above and beyond!
